skill.name: vision-exploration
skill.description: Guide open-ended product vision exploration from a vague idea to multiple future end-state HTML concepts.
skill.summary: Explore ambitious product end states through guided questions, evolution paths, and concept HTML outputs.
skill.author: yunshu0909

content.value_statement: Early product ideas often lack a clear future direction. This skill guides value discovery, user motivation analysis, evolution paths, and multiple visual end-state concepts.
actual_capabilities: Restates a vague idea and checks the user's intended value.
Asks structured questions to uncover real user motivations.
Builds a natural evolution path from simple need to future state.
Generates four to six distinct end-state HTML concepts.
Compares concepts by core idea, scenario, and information architecture.
Organizes final artifacts after the user confirms names and folders.
limitations: It focuses on vision exploration, not implementation planning.
It requires user confirmation at key decision points.
It may produce large HTML concepts that need manual review.
It does not validate technical feasibility or delivery effort.

use_cases.title: Shape A New Feature Vision
use_cases.description: Turn a rough feature idea into several bold future product directions.

use_cases.title: Explore Design Alternatives
use_cases.description: Create distinct interface concepts that differ by interaction model and information structure.

use_cases.title: Frame Strategic Product Options
use_cases.description: Compare long-term product possibilities before selecting a direction for deeper planning.

prompt_templates.title: Start From A Rough Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a rough product idea: [idea]. Help me explore its deepest value and future possibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Find The Real User Need
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the vision-exploration process for [feature]. Ask me questions until we find the real user need.

prompt_templates.title: Map The Evolution Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Based on this value and these user motivations, derive the natural evolution path toward several end states.

prompt_templates.title: Create Distinct Future Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate four to six future-state HTML concepts for [product area]. Make each concept use a different information architecture.

output_examples.input: A dashboard for switching between AI model providers.
output_examples.output: It reframes the value as AI resource management. It proposes event stream, budget cockpit, and autonomous routing concepts.

output_examples.input: A tool for tracking team design decisions.
output_examples.output: It frames the need as preserving product reasoning. It compares timeline, narrative workspace, and consensus map concepts.
The skill explores how the inbox could evolve into insight routing, opportunity discovery, or a strategic voice-of-customer command center.

best_practices: Start with a short idea and let the skill ask clarifying questions.
Confirm each value statement before moving to the next stage.
Review the concept comparison before choosing a direction.
anti_patterns: Do not use it when you only need a fixed UI layout.
Do not skip value discovery and ask for final HTML immediately.
Do not treat the generated concepts as validated engineering plans.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces value framing, user motivation notes, an evolution path, and several future-state HTML concepts.

faq.question: Is this skill for implementation work?
faq.answer: No. It is for product vision and concept exploration before implementation planning.

faq.question: Does it require a detailed brief?
faq.answer: No. A vague idea is enough, but the skill will ask follow-up questions.

faq.question: Can it create multiple design directions?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to create four to six distinct end-state concepts.

faq.question: Does it check technical feasibility?
faq.answer: No. It intentionally focuses on the furthest product possibilities, not current constraints.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
